project.name: Northstar tasks — fictional sample
project.goal: Help a new user create and finish their first task
project.audience: Solo makers organizing a small project
project.task: Create a first task from the empty project view
project.source: Authored UI scenario; no live app or repository connected

evidence.observation: The primary Create task action is visually identical to low-priority settings links and sits below three empty metrics cards.
The first-task action falls below the initial viewport while empty metrics occupy the top of the page.
The empty-state copy says No data yet but gives no reason to create a task or explanation of what happens next.

findings.title: The first-task action is buried behind empty dashboard metrics
findings.proposal: Make task creation the visual primary action in the empty state. Move or suppress metrics until a task exists. Keep the action visible above the fold on mobile.

findings.title: The empty state does not explain the first step
findings.proposal: Replace generic empty copy with a short task-oriented explanation and one concrete example, while preserving a single primary action.

review.before: Authored sample only; no baseline screenshot captured
review.after: No code change or after screenshot yet
